## Legally significant changes

If this changes a legal rule, entitlement calculation, notice period, Section 76
scenario, or public holiday dataset:

- Official source:
- Effective date:
- Rules/data verification date:
- Regression test added or updated:

Do not use a blog, forum post, law-firm summary, or AI-generated text as the
sole authority for a legally significant change.

## Privacy check

- [ ] This change does not send calculator inputs to analytics, logging, session replay, error reporting, or a backend.
- [ ] No real names, employer details, child names, or other unnecessary personal information were added to fixtures, examples, screenshots, or documentation.

If either statement is not true, explain the data flow and update the Privacy
page before release.

Add screenshots for meaningful user-interface changes.
